messages.subject: Group Update: Spam Prevention Measures
parts:
Dear group members,

in December, there were several cases of spam on the group,  with some slipping through automated Google detection and containing potentially harmful links.

To address this, I've adjusted the settings to require moderator approval for posts by new users. Sorry for any inconvenience, but it's a necessary step to keep the group safe.

I apologize to everyone who received these misleading emails from the group, and to new users who will now have to wait for approval of their first post.

As a reminder, only content that is related to camtrapR and its use in wildlife studies on this group is permitted. Please be cautious with group emails and forum posts.

Thank you for your understanding, and Happy New Year!
Jürgen
